name: Being Special
overview: Scripture reveals that every person is uniquely created by God, made in His image with intentional design and purpose, as seen in Genesis 1:26. The psalmist acknowledges God's intimate involvement in our formation, describing how we are fearfully and wonderfully made, intricately crafted even before birth (Psalms 139:13-15). Isaiah affirms our value and honor in God's sight, emphasizing His love and the great price He places on our lives (Isaiah 43:4). Jeremiah further highlights God's personal knowledge and calling for each individual, demonstrating that being special is rooted in God's sovereign plan and divine ordination (Jeremiah 1:5).
